page_topic_one_liner: Schema.org structured data — JSON-LD types, validation, rich results, and entity markup for SEO
differentiator_vs_generic: This is traditional structured-data SEO education, NOT GEO/LLM chat. Hero must show JSON-LD markup connecting to rich-result SERP elements (stars, breadcrumbs, FAQ accordion) — NOT an AI chat panel or LLM citation UI.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Split panel — left: stylized JSON-LD script block with @type Article, headline, author, publisher keys in monospace; right: mini SERP rich-result preview showing breadcrumb trail, 5-star rating row, and FAQ accordion snippet emerging from the code via dotted connector lines
Secondary: entity relationship mini-graph — Organization node linked to Person (author) and WebSite nodes with small type labels
Tertiary: validation checkmark badge overlay (Rich Results Test style) with green pass indicator, no real Google branding
anti_patterns: LLM chat panel as hero (this is Schema markup not GEO)
Generic code editor without rich-result payoff
OpenAI/Anthropic logos or AI Overview chat bubbles
